button-group.$description: Button group: buttons that belong together, touching or apart; a segmented choice when it selects.

attached.$description: Whether the buttons touch, sharing their edges, when not told: true, false.

gap.$description: The space between buttons that do not touch.

item.$description: Each button of the group: its look when the group gives none, and the look of the chosen one.

inner-start.$description: The start corners of a button that touches the one before it.

inner-end.$description: The end corners of a button that touches the one after it.
